Yes, we’re super excited to say we do ship internationally! You can enjoy our gorgeous custom jewellery no matter where you are in the world. For customs and duties, here’s how it works:

For most countries, customs charges and import duties are the customer’s responsibility and aren’t covered by us.
If you’re in the UK or certain European countries, import taxes and duties are included in the price, so there are no extra charges on delivery.
For US orders, a 30% tariff applies from 16 May 2025, and these charges are set by the US government. Unfortunately, we can’t cover these fees.
For the rest of the world, customs charges depend on your local laws and carrier, and you’ll need to pay those if they apply.

If you want all the details, you can check out our full shipping policy here: Shipping Policy.
